title: Riemann zero statistics — an experimental research program
description: A numerical, pre-registered research program on the local statistics of the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function and of Dirichlet L-functions. Contains four research notes (PDF + LaTeX), all measurement scripts, pre-registration files with sha256 timestamps, the research ledger, and an independent replication package. The notes have not been peer reviewed; nothing here claims to bear on a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. Produced with extensive AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic; replication package with DeepSeek); the author takes responsibility for all content.
